question: In economics, CRR stands for ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cash Reserve Ratio**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In economics, **CRR stands for Cash Reserve Ratio**.
 
• This term is often used in the** context of banking, particularly in India**.
 
• **The Cash Reserve Ratio** is a certain percentage of **bank deposits **that banks are required to keep with the **central bank (like the Reserve Bank of India, if we're discussing the Indian context).**
 
• This ratio is one of the instruments in the** toolkit of the central bank **used to** control liquidity in the banking system.**
 
• **A higher CRR** means that banks have less money available to lend out, which can help to slow down the **economy if it is overheating**.
 
• Conversely,** a lower CRR can stimulate economic activity by allowing banks to lend more money**.
 
• The central bank changes the** CRR** as per the requirements of the** economy**.
